Dr. Anita Sharma

Consultant Psychiatrist at Mind Grace

Dr. Sharma provides compassionate, evidence-based psychiatric care for adults and children. Use this page to understand her clinical role, then explore services and booking information for care at Mind Grace in Greater Noida.

Book ConsultationView Services

About Dr. Sharma

Dr. Anita Sharma is a Consultant Psychiatrist at Mind Grace Neuropsychiatric Clinic in Greater Noida.

Consultations consider each person’s concerns and care needs. Treatment discussions may include medication management, psychological support, and follow-up.

At Mind Grace Neuropsychiatric Clinic, she leads a multidisciplinary team committed to reducing stigma and making mental healthcare accessible, confidential, and effective for all patients.

Areas of Expertise

Mood Disorders
Anxiety & Stress
Adult ADHD
Child Development
Sleep Disorders
